Confirm RBAC IDOR for privilege escalation via /rbac/users/{id}/role (chain_004 gate)

Confirm SSRF to Azure IMDS 169.254.169.254 via known SSRF-candidate endpoints (chain_006 gate)
Enumerate horizontal/vertical auth bypass on RBAC API endpoints
Test application-level injection (SQL, NoSQL, command) in Express API routes
Test Pusher WebSocket channel authorization bypass
